{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grohl Liberation Front''' was an organization on the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] that opposed the oppressive rule of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] there in the years of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], and later fought the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They also ended fighting the just established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The group was composed by many members of the [[Grohl Sector Defense Force]], with [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]] was their hero until his breakdown.
